**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION APPROVAL**

**Date:** May 21, 2025  
**Service:** Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (CPT 43644)  
**Decision:** APPROVED

---

**Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement:** Met. Current BMI is 38.8 kg/m² (documented obs-002), exceeding the required minimum of 35 kg/m².

**Obesity-Related Comorbidities:** Met. Patient has two documented active conditions: Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications (onset 12/4/2017, cond-007) and essential hypertension (onset 9/25/2018, cond-009).

**Prior Conservative Treatment:** Met. Medical record documents completion of a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial (doc-004). Net weight loss was 2 kg with subsequent regain after medication discontinuation, documented as unsuccessful by the treating physician.

**Covered Procedure:** Met. Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass is a covered bariatric procedure type.

---

This authorization is valid for 60 days from the date of this letter. Please contact our office if you have questions.
